decisions.reason: Product A builds directly on established glass processing and packaging know-how; its 3D/5G orientation aligns with the firm's high-value proprietary direction and it remains mentioned as a flagship, so absorptive capacity supports keeping it.

Product B extends existing glass structuring capabilities into through-glass vias for semiconductor applications, matching the firm's R&D-intensive, higher-value strategy and benefiting from related knowledge and research partnerships.
